parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance to which the resource whose tags you want to query belongs.

> This parameter is required when you query the tags of a topic or a group.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that determines the start point of the next query.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource whose tags you want to query. Valid values:

*   **INSTANCE**
*   **TOPIC**
*   **GROUP**

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that you want to query. A maximum of 20 tags can be included in the list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons list-tag-resources --instance-id MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --resource-type TOPIC --next-token caeba00000be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --tag Value=ServiceA Key=CartService --resource-id test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 test --Tag.1.Key CartService --NextToken caeba00000be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --InstanceId MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --Tag.1.Value ServiceA --ResourceType TOPIC
